verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping SaaS, and such a service could plausibly offer an API or headless automation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only web and in-app surfaces: account connections, reports and downloads, and messaging with bookkeepers. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404, so nothing shows a headless, CLI or CI-runnable mode.
